contexts.text: The healing of the understanding alone, would be like palliative healing...
The good in the external man (merely) is like a wound healed palliatively, within which there is putrid matter.

For man to compel himself to do good to the neighbour... while he has not compelled himself to [abstain] from evils... would be like a palliative cure, by which the disease or ulcer is healed outwardly.
Thus, and not otherwise, is the ulcer opened and healed; otherwise it is a palliative cure.
If this little work is not added to the former one... it would be like a palliative cure only...
